rank_context: Diamond Ana players generally understand basic mechanics and healing output, but plateau due to passive utility usage (defensive heal-nades instead of fight-winning anti-nades), wasting Sleep Dart before enemy dive commits, poor Nano Boost tempo/economy, and healbotting tanks instead of weaving damage.

rules.timeline_condition: Count across match: ratio of Biotic Grenades used for offensive purple anti-heal (`offensive_anti`) vs defensive yellow heal (`defensive_heal` / `self_heal`).
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio}), you used Biotic Grenade for {actual_target} instead of looking for an offensive anti-heal during the engagement window. Across the match, your offensive anti-nade ratio is only {offensive_anti_pct}% (Diamond-to-Master benchmark is >= 50%).
rules.actionable_fix: When your Tank is above 50% HP and near natural cover, sustain them with primary fire and hold Biotic Grenade (E) until enemy defensive cooldowns (Barrier/Suzu/Fortify) are forced, then splash enemy frontline or flankers for a decisive anti-heal.

rules.timeline_condition: Enemy composition contains dive/flank threat AND player fires Sleep Dart at range >15m at enemy frontline/tank (`poke_lottery_sleep`) AND player is dove or killed within 14 seconds while Sleep Dart is on cooldown.
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio}), with active enemy dive threats ({enemy_threats}), you fired a low-percentage poke Sleep Dart at [{sleep_used_time}] targeting {sleep_target}. You were dove and killed {seconds_later}s later while Sleep Dart was still on cooldown ({cd_remaining}s remaining).
rules.actionable_fix: Against dive tanks or flankers, never fire 'lottery' Sleep Darts at the enemy frontline during the poke phase. Hold Sleep Dart strictly as your anti-dive insurance until enemy flankers/dive tanks commit their mobility cooldowns.

rules.category: Nano Boost Fight Economy & Number Advantage
rules.timeline_condition: Player activates Ultimate (Nano Boost) when `ally_alive - enemy_alive <= -2` (e.g., 3v5, 2v4) OR holds 100% Ultimate charge for > 90 seconds across lost/neutral fights.
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}], the killfeed showed a {alive_ratio} disadvantage (key allies eliminated: {dead_allies}). Investing Nano Boost onto {nano_target} in an already-lost fight wasted a major ultimate and crippled your next fight's economy.
rules.actionable_fix: Check the top-right killfeed before pressing Q: if your team is down 2+ players or your Tank is dead, wipe and reset immediately. Instead, use Nano Boost proactively in 5v5 or 4v4 neutral fights as soon as your core teammate commits.

rules.category: Healbot Tunnel Vision vs. Offensive Damage Weaving
rules.timeline_condition: Player fires >= 4 consecutive shots into allies at >85% HP while enemy squishies/supports are visible in line of sight, OR remains hard-scoped > 3.5 seconds in open sightline.
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio}), while your frontline was healthy (>{ally_hp_pct}% HP), you remained hard-scoped healing teammates for {duration}s, missing an open window to pressure {exposed_enemy}.
rules.actionable_fix: Break the Diamond healbot habit: whenever allies are above 70% HP and not taking burst damage, weave 1-2 offensive taps onto exposed enemy DPS/Supports between healing shots (3 unscoped/scoped hits eliminate or force out a 225-250 HP target).
